name: path2-measurement-prereqs
description: Native-only Path 2 measurement corpus combining the existing native-lowering starter rows with explicit expected-error probes, range-step/time-offset variants, and dataset-variant parity rows.

coverageBuckets.name: native_success
coverageBuckets.purpose: Rows that are already expected to succeed through Path 2 in native-only mode.

coverageBuckets.name: expected_error
coverageBuckets.purpose: Rows that validate Prometheus-compatible public error envelopes.

coverageBuckets.name: range_step_and_offset_variants
coverageBuckets.purpose: Rows that expand time offsets and range-step matrix combinations for boundary-sensitive selector behavior.

coverageBuckets.name: dataset_variants
coverageBuckets.purpose: Rows that force reset/gap, churn/staleness, and histogram-burst dataset shapes through the native-only harness path.
